views.title: George, suplex: G7 → Rev 3
views.blurb: Same scenario (Lou throws, George receives), both runs end on a back clutch and stay on his back. Left: G7 (Rev 2, f334b46). Right: Rev 3: the hand goes round the body, the depth swaps only while the hand is clear of the art, and the forearm stays over the upper arm.

views.title: George, suplexFlip: G7 → Rev 3
views.blurb: The other side: George faces right at impact.

views.title: George, rolled → prone rise: G7 → Rev 3
views.blurb: A plan where George rolls onto his front first, then clutches his back. The prone rise has no hand on the back (unchanged rule); the hand is held behind the body until it clears, comes out, and goes back round when the standing recovery starts.
